main.description: Creates an automation account in an organization, for CI to publish as, and returns its app password, which the host does not show again. The caller must be an admin of the organization. The account can sign in with the password, write attestations to its own repository, and call this host's methods, and nothing else.

organization.description: The organization, whose handle is a scope on this host.

name.description: The first label of the account's handle in the scope.

errors.name: QuotaExceeded
errors.description: The organization has as many automation accounts as the host allows.
